title: Synastry vs Composite
caption:
synastry vs composite: what's the difference? 🌙
Synastry is the two of you. A composite is the us.

ask: Most people never learn this one.
explainA: to see how you affect each other.
explainB: A *composite* blends both charts into one,
the chart of the relationship itself.
